messages:
jamie (PM): Quick sync — posting the PRD draft for the rerank + embeddings API adjustments. Need a tight review: acceptance criteria, edge cases, and rollout gating. TL;DR: we want an optional rerank endpoint, embedding hints param, and a backward-compatible deprecation plan. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can review today.

alex (eng): Looking now. main concerns: latency and memory for batching when rerank is called inline with chat. Will this be sync or async by default?

priya (ML): From the model side: rerank should accept precomputed embeddings or compute on the fly. Need clear semantics for similarity metric and tie-breakers. Also define eval set for quality gating.

mike (eng): On API contract: propose adding param `rerank.strategy` with values ["score_only","reorder"]. Keep `embeddings.source` optional ("precomputed" / "service"). Backwards compatible: default to old behavior. Example snippet:```json
{
  "model": "redwood-search-1",
  "input": "...",
  "rerank": {"strategy": "reorder", "top_k": 10},
  "embeddings": {"source": "service"}
}```

jamie (PM): Good. Acceptance criteria I'm proposing in the doc (copied):
- Functionality: rerank endpoint returns stable ordering for same input + top_k semantics.
- Quality: lift NDCG@10 by >= 6% on internal eval set vs baseline.
- Latency: p95 for rerank request (end-to-end) <= 180ms for top_k <= 10 on Dedicated tier.
- Cost: incremental token spend per rerank <= 12% of baseline for typical workloads.
- Compatibility: existing completions/chat APIs unchanged unless `rerank` param present.
Guessing we need separate gates for Hosted vs Dedicated.

priya (ML): For edge cases: near-duplicate docs, empty result sets, long document inputs (>8k tokens), and multilingual embeddings. Need to state fallback semantics: if embeddings missing -> compute; if compute fails -> return original order + error flag: `rerank.fallback: true`. Add tests: synthetic duplicate clusters, adversarial paraphrases.

alex (eng): Implementation note: prefer streaming-friendly path — allow early return where reordering happens client-side if customer passes `embeddings.precompute=true`. Otherwise server does on-the-fly. Also mention memory cap per-request (e.g., max 4k vectors). Without that we OOM on Dedicated smaller GPUs.

dina (prodops): Rollout plan suggestions: canary on Dedicated GPU pools -> 10% traffic for 48h; metric checks: error rate, p95 latency, cost delta, and quality delta from canary eval set. If error rate > 1% or p95 > 250ms or quality regresses > 2% then auto-rollback. Also need telemetry keys: `rerank.top_k`, `rerank.strategy`, `embeddings.source`, `model.variant`.

mike (eng): Edge-API detail: add `mode` query param for async rerank: `mode=sync|async`. Async returns job id and polling endpoint. That helps heavy re-rank jobs.

jamie (PM): Good catch. Let's add async as an explicit acceptance criterion for top_k > 100 or doc corpus > 10k. Also add security note: embeddings precomputed via customer KMS should never be cached in plaintext.

priya (ML): One more: evaluation metrics list to include — NDCG@5/10, MRR, precision@k, and a robustness score for paraphrase clusters. We'll attach evaluation harness.

alex (eng): Minor request: please add rollout traffic tag in console so support can filter requests to canary customers.

lighthouse-bot: AUTO: New draft PRD uploaded: https://redwood.internal/prd/1824501123 (jamie). CI checks: doc lint passed.

jamie (PM): Thanks all. Action items:
- alex, mike: update API contract snippet and add streaming/async section (owner: alex + mike) — EOD
- priya: attach eval harness and baseline numbers — EOD
- dina: draft canary/rollback policy + telemetry list — tomorrow AM
I'll consolidate and open RFC once updates in. Ping me on threads. :pray:
